title: PageBuilder implementation mapping
summary: One PageBuilder seam for full/isolated builds with early physical-route selection and hash-checked layout composition of its rendered main result.
current_behavior: BuildCommand calls one monolithic PortableSiteBuilder::build for full and --page modes.
Two full M0 builds and one isolated badge rebuild produced an identical 321-file manifest.
Single-page output is atomic by copying the complete previous build into a candidate directory.
Generated component/example pages enter DeclarativePipeline::buildGenerated with trustedMainHtml.
M2 routes all authored pages through one PageBuilder seam; Badge returns typed in-memory IR and 16 component artifacts while other routes retain the rollback adapter.
Full and isolated Badge builds call the same PageBuilder and are byte-identical; only the route set selected by PortableSiteBuilder differs.
M3.2 selects an isolated physical route before compiling pages or running component-catalog/declarative-example projectors, while preserving the same PageBuilder and final publication loop.
Alert full and isolated trees are byte-identical and an observer proves unrelated projections are not entered.
Batch 07 replaces the per-route target whitelist with one content/(ru/)?components/<slug>.md boundary, so every new physical component owner automatically uses the same typed PageBuilder.
Batch 10 passes PageBuilder rendered main HTML into declarative layout composition for authored and projected pages and fails closed if composition changes its hash.
A full build writes one hash-bound disposable backlink projection; an isolated build reuses it for the selected route without compiling other pages, and full/single trees remain exact.
known_deviations: Generated-route isolated builds still require their legacy projections until those routes become physical.
The target PageBuilder path is proven for every current physical component page; remaining generated routes retain their projector rollback adapter.
Generated pages still originate in bounded projectors before their rendered main result enters the same layout-composition seam.
deletion_gates: Delete buildGenerated/trustedMainHtml only after every generated route has migrated to physical Markdown and PageBuilder parity passes.
Move --page selection before global projection only after dependency/index update tests prove bounded work.
Split SiteBuilder from PageBuilder only with full/single HTML, asset, metadata, heading, link and diagnostic parity.
